quifael: A modest wizard's mansion standing alone beside a green city park, with the great walls and domes of Midgaard rising behind it. A crooked laboratory tower leans off one side, trailing faint violet vapour. Small details: a glass-walled nook on the garden side with a tiny tentacled thing pressed against the panes, a doorway whose frame glows with faint portal light, a weathervane shaped like a star. Accent: pale violet on the laboratory tower windows.
immort: Asgard seen from the foot of the Rainbow Bridge: a pale arc of misty light rising into clouds toward a hall of timber and gold, with a pantheon of divine halls drifting on a high plateau of cloud. Small details: a tiny armoured watcher on the bridge with a great horn at his belt, a cosy lynx den cave dug into the cloud bank with a lantern glowing inside, a small chapel with a faint halo above its roof. Accent: a barely-there pale gold on the bridge and the hall roof.
casino: A domed gambling hall at dusk, seen from across a cobbled square on a city street, striped awnings, a long roulette hall visible through tall arched windows. Small details: a giant matchbox with a tiny racing insect harnessed to it on the front steps, a plump old woman in a dandelion-yellow dress behind a token counter in the lit doorway, a nightingale perched on the roof ridge, scattered oversized dice by the door. Accent: dull crimson in the awnings and faint gold in the windows. The facade carries no signs and no lettering.
plains: Wide northern steppe under a big sky, tall grasses and wildflowers rolling to distant foothills, an old road winding toward a small walled town on the horizon. Small details: ancient menhir mounds scattered over the grass, a tiny hermit's campfire with a rabbit roasting beside a hut among the hills, a nomad tent with a pole bearing a bronze tablet, and a vast pale worm-head just breaking out of a hillside tunnel far away. Accent: muted violet on the steppe flowers and dull red on the worm.
tofemida: The Temple of Themis seen from its gates: a severe white-columned courthouse over a steep stair, a statue of a blindfolded goddess with scales on the roof, and a dungeon level visible as barred windows cut into the foundations below. Small details: a tall witness dock standing out on the portico, a tiny spring of clear water running by the steps, a small spider hovering above one barred cell window, a long row of numbered cell doors glimpsed through the arches. Accent: cold pale blue on the scales and the statue.
gnome: A peaceful gnome village of tiny round-doored houses at the foot of tall southern mountains, a stream crossing the village road. Far to the north a gloomy fortress with a dungeon gate, and to the east hills with a hobgoblin barracks with horned helms on spikes. Small details: a mine entrance with a cart of ore, a faint fiery bat circling a tower, a small stone altar glowing dark, a basket of grain by a gnome door. Accent: warm amber in the window lights and dull red in the hobgoblin fort.
air: A view from high above Midgaard: the city's temple square and rooftops far below like a toy map, a bed of soft clouds around, and a strange pale astral glow gathering at the very top of the sky. Small details: a griffon with huge black wings gliding in the distance, a small fairy-tale dragon curled around a cloud, a single red rose drifting upward, a tiny floating island of rock. Accent: pale rose pink on the clouds at the horizon and faint silver in the astral glow.
dark2: The Dark Continent seen from a ship arriving at a hot beach: palm groves, a small backwater village with a stone well, a rope bridge over a green gorge, and alpine meadows rising to distant ragged peaks. Small details: a huge ape-like monkey sitting on a rooftop, a half-buried treasure chest with a rolled map beside it on the sand, a lone tower on the west cliff with a lantern, a wheelbarrow of coins left on the beach. Accent: warm sand-gold on the beach and muted green on the palms.
arachnos: A vast dark forest of towering trees knitted together by enormous glistening spider webs, strands crossing the ravines like bridges, and a thin cave mouth at the base of the largest trunk. Small details: a gigantic black spider silhouette on a far web, a baby dragon hatchling nest in a high branch, a hermit's tiny hut perched in a treetop, a huge dragon eye glowing in a lair deep under the roots. Accent: sickly violet on the webs and dull red on the dragon eye.
amber_floor1: Amber Castle seen from the sea: a tall pale stone fortress on a cliff with many floors of lit windows, a main hall with huge doors, long winding staircases visible inside a tower. Small details: a keg of dark beer on the quay beside a servant, an oversized stone moon-like green orb set in the tower, a sly grin hanging in the air above one balcony like a cat's, a bookcase wall glimpsed in a lit library window. Accent: warm amber in the windows and faded jade on the green orb.
gstrong: A grim goblin stronghold in a dark forest: a crooked fortress of jagged stone with a few huge boulders levitating above its walls, smoke rising from barracks, and a spiked gate at the main entrance. Small details: a goblin jester with a tall floppy hat dancing on the wall, a shaman's hut with bones on strings at the side, a stone banquet table heaped with food seen through the gate, a small imp-like demon perched on a tower. Accent: sickly green on the torches and dull red on the gate.
eastern: The Sands of Sorrow: endless hot dunes under a hard sky, a distant caravan of camels on a ridge, a black cave mouth in the foot of eastern mountains with a dark river flowing out. Small details: a huge mushroom-shaped temple half buried in the sand, a dervish whirling beside a striped warriors' tent, a brass dragon curled asleep on a dune top, patches of strange glowing sand near a cave. Accent: faint glowing turquoise on the mushroom temple and sand patches.
shaolin: An ancient mountain monastery of upturned tiled roofs built on steep terraces, reached by a long mountain stair through mist, with a main courtyard at the centre. Small details: a wooden practice dummy with arms outstretched in the courtyard, a tiny drunk old man sitting on the steps with a jug, a hot bun steaming on a windowsill, a candle flame glowing inside a lone mountain shrine, a small dragon-shaped finial on the topmost roof. Accent: faded vermillion on the pagoda roofs.
mahntor: The fortress city of Mahn-Tor on a cold bleak coast: massive stone walls with horned gate towers, a harem tower with fine arches, and a grey sea with floating ice in front. Small details: a minotaur guard silhouette on the gate wall, an ogre village fire pit smoke on a rocky shore far to the left, a ghostly knight in dark red armour standing alone at the edge of the mist, an old twisted tree with a face in the trunk. Accent: dark red steel on the gate and faint cold blue on the ice.
mirror2: A kingdom split in two halves: the left half sunlit with a white temple and green meadows, the right half dark with a black forest and storm clouds, divided by a perfectly straight line, with a huge cracked mirror standing in the middle like a gate. Small details: a phoenix perched on a white spire, a beekeeper's hives in the meadow, a fisherman's hut on a pond, a black tower with a tiny red window. Accent: pale gold on the light half and deep violet on the dark half.
ryzen2: The entrance to the Caverns of the Damned at the foot of southern mountains: a wide jagged cave mouth with a worn stair leading down, a crystal cavern gleaming faintly inside, and a distant lich tower on a ridge. Small details: a ghostly spectre drifting at the mouth, a deep dragon's glowing eye far down in the dark, a carved bone key hung on a stake by the stair, a small red glow of a stairway down to hell at the deepest point. Accent: sickly green on the spectre and deep red in the depths.
prison: The Prison of Midgaard: a squat grey fortress compound with spiral staircase towers, an exercise yard with high walls, a tall stash tower and a guardroom gatehouse. Small details: a bronze dragon lying calmly on the roof of the main block like a cat, a prison cook's kitchen chimney smoking, a mop and bucket by the gate, a large hatch to the sky in a tower. Accent: dull yellow in the barred windows and faint green on the toxic puddle.
westland: The marshy lands of Westland: a lakeside path winding past a hill toward the walled town of Hartland, swamp islands with dead trees, and a dark palace on the horizon with towers like fangs. Small details: a boundary warden on a hill in shining armour, a small hut with bones hung from the eaves on a forest trail, a great red dragon asleep on a distant ridge, a ghostly figure in the fog on the swamp. Accent: dark red in the palace windows and muted green on the swamp water.
gtown: A ruined accursed city in thick fog at the headwaters of a dark river: broken houses, a town square with a cracked temple of a horned demon, and a walled garden with unnaturally bright flowers. Small details: a vampire baron's tower with a single lit window, a crypt with an open door and green light, a hand-shaped pillar in the main square, ghostly shapes drifting between the walls, a lich silhouette on a roof. Accent: pale ghost-blue in the fog and dull crimson in the temple.
amber_city: The City of Amber from a gentle slope: crowded old streets running toward a great square with a white temple of a unicorn at the end, narrow lanes between tall houses. Small details: a mule caravan arriving at the gate, an empty gilded picture frame hanging on a house wall, a cloaked figure at the end of a lane, a pair of horseshoes nailed above the temple door, an oversized stone sandwich on a plinth. Accent: warm amber on the lit windows and faded white on the temple.
metro: An underground railway station seen down a long tiled platform: a stubby old locomotive-shaped train waiting at the edge, arched vaulted ceiling lit by hanging lamps, tunnel mouths fading into dark. Small details: four little brass pictogram plaques on the wall showing a castle, a fountain, a meadow and a flame, a tiny wishing-fountain mosaic on the wall, a sleepy ticket booth with a lantern. Accent: dull amber on the lamps and train windows.
galeon: A great wooden galleon at sea under a pale sky, tall masts and patched sails, a quarterdeck at the stern, a beach and small island on the horizon. Small details: a rope ladder reaching up to a crow's nest, a cannon-and-armory hatch open on the deck, a gull perched on the bowsprit with a tiny bell tied to it, distant figures at the rail. Accent: faded teal on the sea and sail trim.
masquerade: An old walled medieval city with tall towers, rooftops draped in festival garlands and hanging paper masks, a great gate glowing at dusk as if a carnival has begun, a dark horde of tents gathering far beyond the walls. Small details: giant stone mask faces set into the tower walls, a lone figure on a rooftop with a feathered mask, confetti drifting over a balcony. Accent: muted magenta and old gold on the masks and garlands.
redferne: A cloud castle floating above the sky, seen from below: a gigantic chain stretching down through the clouds toward the earth, pale towers and a mansion crowning a flat cloud island. Small details: the endless chain links with a tiny climbing figure far down, a cloud-kitchen chimney puffing smoke, an artifact hall with a glint of a relic in a high window, a knight's pennant. Accent: pale silver-blue on the chain and cloud edges, a touch of dull red on the pennant.
circus: A travelling circus camped outside a city wall: a big striped tent with flags, a ring of wagons with locked doors, a Ferris-less wooden stand. Small details: an elephant behind iron bars, a tightrope strung high between two poles with a tiny walker, a cotton candy stall with a puff of pink, a padlock on every wagon. Accent: faded red and cream on the tent stripes.
valley: A hidden green valley between steep forested ridges in the far north, seen from a high pass: ancient tall trees with graceful houses built among their branches, a thin stream winding through, mist at dawn. Small details: slender elven watchtowers camouflaged in the canopy, a winding narrow path with a tiny rider, a storeroom built into a hollow trunk. Accent: soft silver-green on the leaves and watchtowers.
ofcol2: A growing northern town on a plain, with a stone watch wall, smithy smoke, a pub with a hanging lamp, farmland fields and dirt roads leading in. Small details: a golden dragon statue on a pedestal in the central square, a small distillery with a copper still and steam, a pigsty beside a house, a lone armored woman on the wall. Accent: dull gold on the dragon statue.
solace: A cosy little town built among tall trees by a calm lake, houses and walkways high in the branches, a gate with a watchtower, lanterns and a market square. Small details: a vegetable cart with a striped awning, a little diving shop with an old copper helmet hung outside, a freezer shed with frost on the roof, tree-top bridges between houses. Accent: warm amber in the windows and lanterns.
astral: The Astral Plane: a vast silver void of drifting mist and stars, a rainbow arching up from below into it, a lone pale gate floating in the distance, a thin silver strip road crossing the emptiness. Small details: a tiny rider on a silver strip, a faint fortress silhouette on a drifting rock far away, a gate of stone arch hanging in nothing, bits of lost islands. Accent: pale violet on the gate and rainbow edge.
knightcastle: A stern grey fortress with a lowered drawbridge over a moat at dusk, round towers with pennants, a donjon rising behind the walls, a stable wing glimpsed within. Small details: a pair of horses at a stable door, a raised portcullis with iron teeth, a tiny sentry on the keep. Accent: deep blue and a touch of white on the pennants.
chaos: A crooked citadel of mismatched towers leaning at odd angles on a barren hill, a dark temple at the centre, doors and stairs that lead nowhere, a sky that swirls. Small details: a staircase ending in thin air, a clock with too many hands over the gate, a door hanging on a tower wall with nothing around it, mixed-up shapes floating nearby. Accent: dull magenta and green on the temple glow.
battlerager: A mountain cavern mouth cut into rocky cliffs, seen from a dusty canyon: a wide stone landing leading to a sunken arena in the cave, iron spikes and torches along the rim. Small details: a huge lizard curled asleep on a rock ledge, bone trophies hung over the entrance, weapon racks around the arena, a sanctum glowing deep inside. Accent: dull crimson on the torchlight and trophies.
chess2: A giant black and white chequered plain stretching to the horizon like a chessboard, with tall stone chess pieces standing as statues and soldiers. Small details: a black knight piece with a glinting eye, a treasury chest tucked behind a rook, a tiny player in the distance moving a pawn, a grocer's cart at the board edge. Accent: muted gold on the king crown and chest.
lake: A still salt lake hidden in a dark emerald forest, mist on the water, reeds along the shore, an underwater palace glowing faintly beneath the surface and a grotto in the cliffs. Small details: a lone weeping willow bending over the shore, a faint glowing spire under the water, a tiny boat adrift without a rower, a few teardrop-shaped pearls on the rocks. Accent: pale blue-silver on the water glow.
orodruin: A black volcano seen from an ash-covered road on its northern slope, a fiery crack in its side pouring a red glow, ash clouds over the sky. Small details: a narrow path winding up to the crack, a tiny lone traveller far below, scattered scorched bones on the road, a lava river crossing the way. Accent: dull orange-red on the lava crack.
coven: A dark forest of tall black pines near a small logging town, an abandoned logging camp, a muddy track and a crossroads, a hidden cave glowing in the trees. Small details: a rough wooden house with lit windows on the main street, stumps and felled logs rotting at the camp, a witch's ring of candles in a glade, a stairway to a hidden attic. Accent: sickly green on the cave glow and candles.
hut: An enormous magical hut seen in a forest clearing: a wooden house standing tall on giant chicken legs, windows glowing, chimney smoking, a spiral stair visible going down into its depths. Small details: a lantern hanging on a pole, a shop with a stuffed-bottle shelf visible through a window, a patch of sand and grass nearby, a tiny stool left outside. Accent: warm orange in the windows.
weed: A rolling meadow overgrown with huge leafy plants towering like trees, a great central stalk with a hut at its base, hazy smoke drifting among the leaves. Small details: a hammock strung between two giant stalks, a tiny smoking snail on a leaf, a wooden peace sign carved in a trunk, beaded curtain at a doorway. Accent: soft green with a touch of red-yellow on the beads and hammock.
divsouls: A wild divided land: on one side a bright garden of mossy paths, a great tree with a giant birdfeeder in its branches, and a misty pool, on the other a shadowy cave and dark stone hall. Small details: a strange sculpture beside the path, a big birdfeeder with small birds, a tiny druid figure near the tree, dark banners at the far cave entrance. Accent: pale gold on the garden side and deep violet on the dark cave.
unholy: A dark abbey hidden in distant mountain spurs, seen across a deep chasm with a narrow bridge: gaunt towers and cloisters, a bell tower, smoke coming from forges, a rocky road winding up. Small details: bellows and a forge glow in a lower window, a ring of portal arches in the courtyard, skeletal sentries along the walls, a draconic carved crest on the gate. Accent: sickly green on the portal glow and deep red on the forge.
intro: The tiny harbour town of Moehewa seen from the hills above: a crooked quay, moored fishing boats, a market square and a ring of town walls with a welcome gate. Small details: a striped sage's tent on the green, a doctor's shuttered examination hut with a green lamp, a dead-end alley with a single lonely barrel. Accent: soft green on the sage's tent and the harbour lamps.
gerghlm2: The young walled city of Gerighelm at the edge of a great forest: new stone towers, scaffolding and cranes on a construction site, a grim prison tower, and a knights' castle inside the walls. Small details: a clock-faced Church of Time with a stopped hand, a green park with a caretaker's cottage, a sewer outflow into the river with a half-flooded library entrance. Accent: pale steel white on the castle banners' poles and slate blue on the prison roof.
dream: A gigantic dreaming machine seen as a floating cube built of weathered stone and timber blocks, three by three by three, hovering over a snowy valley. Below it the cosy village of Newfane with an old wooden church, a Yule tree farm and a great dance hall glowing with warm windows. Small details: tiny costumed morris dancers with bells on the village green, a frozen pond, a door in the cube's side opening on a different sky. Accent: one faded red face on the cube.
school: The upper floors of the Temple of Leo turned into a school: a sunlit stone tower with big classroom windows, and beside it a round sand arena ringed by walls and cages. Small details: a wobbling green blob peering from a barred cage, tiny novices with wooden swords in the arena, a diploma scroll hanging from the highest window. Accent: warm gold on the temple roof and dull green on the blob.
smidgaard: Southern Midgaard across the Dark River: arched bridges, a calm park pond, a broad avenue, a town hall and prison, and two temples side by side. Small details: a bright Sun Temple with a golden disc opposite a black Dark Temple spire, a tiny diner with a neon-less awning near the park, a gate tower with a guard barely visible. Accent: pale gold on the Sun Temple and deep violet on the Dark Temple.
draconia: The Dragon Castle of the draconians: a black fortress tower rising out of a gloomy Grove of Shadows, bridges and ledges clinging to a mountain. Small details: three dragons of white, black and red resting on separate ledges, lizard-men with scaled wings circling the battlements, a crypt entrance and a wine cellar door at the base. Accent: dull crimson on the red dragon and the tower windows.
crystal2: A huge clear lake ringed by steep ridges and fields, with the small town of Solace on the shore and a stone bridge crossing a gorge. Small details: the vague shadow of a giant turtle-dragon under the water, an abandoned camp with a cold fire, twin peaks with a tiny hut under one of them, wheat fields on the north shore. Accent: pale turquoise on the lake and soft gold on the wheat.
haon: The vast ancient forest of Haon Dor seen from above its canopy, old trees, glades and a river winding through. Small details: a cave with a skull-shaped rock where the deathless sorcerer hides, a lumberjack's cabin in a clearing, a tiny lion on a rock at the end of a trail. Accent: dull emerald on the deepest treetops and warm amber in the cabin window.
shalafi2: The Tower of the Order of Shalafi: a tall slender scholars' tower of pale stone with an observatory dome on top, rising above misty hills. Small details: seven glowing seals ringing a window halfway up, smoke curling from a window of the smoke room, a telescope pointing at the sky, tiny figures in blue robes on the steps. Accent: cool blue on the dome and the seal glow.
nation: The Goblin Nation: an endless ocean of tall grass on a slow river, and a village of wattle huts and straw hovels with a palisade wall. Small details: a lone blue shack among the brown huts, a goblin war canoe in the rapids, a shaman's totem pole with a skull, a few goblins looking out over the grass. Accent: muted blue on the shack and olive green on the totem.
mirkwd2: A sinister vast old forest, a crooked path vanishing between huge black trunks, with a guard post and a ravaged burnt patch at the edge. Small details: giant spider webs strung between trees like grey curtains, a lone cliff lookout, a ploughed field at the forest edge, a glade with a faint pale glow. Accent: sickly grey-green on the webs and a dull rust on the burnt trees.
ghostcavern: A mountain cavern entrance with a cursed wasteland before it, and inside, the faint stone octagon of the Ghost Clan hall. Small details: a pale transparent figure keeping watch on a ledge, an empty altar glowing under the vault, a magic forge with embers deep inside, a corridor lined with floating lost-soul wisps. Accent: pale grey-blue on the ghost wisps and a faint orange in the forge.
under2: A colossal underground nation seen as a huge cavern city, tiers of black stone towers and streets lit by phosphorescent fungus, far under the world. Small details: a giant floating eye hovering as the law, a purple worm coiling through a tunnel, a spider-shaped drow tower, dwarf forges glowing on the cavern floor. Accent: violet on the fungus lamps and dim red on the forges.
chapel: The ruined old chapel on a hill above the Midgaard graveyard, with a stairwell going down into darkness, and cutaway hints of vast crypts below. Small details: rows of kings' tombs each with a stone coffin lid, a lone undead rising from a crypt entrance, a stairwell lit by a single candle. Accent: ash white on the tombs and a faint green on the candle.
songs: A surreal landscape stitched from song lyrics: a road winding to nowhere, a reed bank, a house at the setting sun, a railway station called rock bottom, a watchtower and a burning stairway climbing into the sky. Small details: a glowing stairway to the clouds, a tiny English garden, a train on rails fading into blue distance. Accent: dusk orange on the setting sun and blue haze on the distance.
arcadia: Arcadia, the elven kingdom: a flower meadow, an enchanted wood and a lake with a bridge to a castle island, with watchtowers on a hill. Small details: a small tavern with a dog's tail sign swinging, a smithy chimney smoking in the hills, a forbidden chamber window glowing in the castle, light and dark court pavilions side by side. Accent: soft lilac on the castle and pale silver on the lake.
tohell: The descent to Hell: a metro station platform at the edge of a fiery pit, stone arches and black stairs leading down into red darkness. Small details: a fountain flowing with blood, a skeleton factory with smoking chimneys, a fresco of the dead on an arch wall, a distant figure with horns by the gate. Accent: deep red on the fire pit and dull gold on the pile of coins.
ciquala2: The Lair of Ciquala: a gnarled huge tree with a large opening in its trunk, a stairway descending into darkness, and a hint of an underground complex below. Small details: a pale lich silhouette on a throne under the ground, a pool of glowing water, rows of automaton statues in a hall, a hidden crypt door. Accent: cold teal on the pool and bone white on the lich's crown.
tcwnn: The wealthy trading city of Anon seen from the southern road: broad avenues of victory leading to a temple, gates east and west, rooftops and smithy chimneys. Small details: a crowd of tiny stalls around an avenue, a wonderworker's tower with sparks flying, embassy flags of many races, ruins of an old city on the horizon. Accent: warm gold on the temple dome and the flags.
drakyri: Drakyri Isle in the middle of a lake: a wooded island with silvery gates, a grey tower, and a blue stone courtyard behind a wall. Small details: six noble houses shown as six pennants of different colours on a tower, a mirrored hall window catching the sun, a spiral stairwell tower, a wooded path leading to a strange grove. Accent: sapphire blue on the courtyard and silver on the gates.
satyr: A sunny grassy reserve of rolling pastures seen from a hill, dotted with play lawns, a bellflower meadow and a little fairy hill, a wooden gate at the edge. Small details: a tall stone monument in the middle of a lawn, a lopsided sandcastle in a sandbox, a tiny satyr cub with stubby horns trotting after a centauress far off. Accent: soft bellflower violet on the meadow.
smurf: A hidden village of tiny round mushroom houses with white caps, tucked inside giant berry bushes heavy with fruit, a shaded path winding in. Small details: a stout well in the lane, a dark crooked little castle with a lurking ginger cat on the far ridge, tiny blue-skinned folk in white pointed caps waving from doorways. Accent: muted sky blue on the villagers and caps, dull red on the berries.
midgaard: The walled capital city of Midgaard seen from a low hill: a great domed temple of the sun god over crowded roofs, guild towers and a market square, smoke from an inn chimney. Small details: a wild boar weathervane on the inn, a tiny portal shimmering inside the temple doors, a lost-and-found cart heaped with odd belongings by the gate. Accent: faint muted gold on the temple dome.
mirror: The ruined old human city of Old Midgaard under a dark sky, a wrecked temple on the central square, a crumbling east gate, bats over broken roofs. Small details: a pale bank building with a carved stone bat over its door, rows of mechanical golem workshops with stone limbs piled outside, a barrel dripping dark blood beside an old fountain, a mangy tiny dog on the street. Accent: dull crimson in the barrel and a few lit windows.
mgoose: A whole landscape shaped like a giant open storybook, pages curling into hills, a meadow page, a glade page and a river running between spreads, ink-line trees printed on paper. Small details: a huge egg-shaped man sitting on a wall in the distance, a tiny spider dangling over a tuffet, a page corner blotted with old ink, a dish running away with a spoon. Accent: faded red on the cover binding.
canyon: A deep mountain canyon seen from an overlook, with four zones along its floor: a river bay, a fiery garden, an electric crackling path and dark earthen caves. Small details: a lone grave on a mountain trail in the foreground, a huge elemental gate of carved stone at the canyon mouth, a waterfall hanging in mid-air, tiny pebble and flame creatures far below. Accent: muted orange on the fiery garden, cold cyan on the water bay.
olympus: Snow-capped Mount Olympus with a marble city and a columned castle on its slopes, clouds drifting below the terraces, roads named for gods winding up. Small details: a winged horse resting on a cliff edge, a bolt of lightning held frozen over the throne room roof, an empty abandoned feast table with a golden fruit bowl on a terrace, a small forge smoking at the side. Accent: pale gold on the columns and thunder light.
shire: Rolling sepia hills with only a hint of sage green, dotted with round-doored burrows, a stone bridge over a slow river and a windmill, a village green with a tavern. Small details: a turnip statue in the village square, pigs and chickens in tiny fenced yards, a tiny kindergarten hut with a swing, a lone robed wizard with a pointed hat smoking a pipe on a hill. Accent: warm yellow on burrow doors and window lights.
pyramid: A great sandstone pyramid rising from endless desert dunes under a pale sun, a swirling sandstorm on the horizon, a stepped climb up its side. Small details: a sphinx statue lying at the pyramid foot, a magic carpet floating over a dune, a lamp-shaped glow at the summit, bleached bones of tomb robbers half buried in sand. Accent: muted turquoise on the sphinx headdress, gold at the apex.
outsider: A lonely mountain tavern by a still lake, perched beside a rope suspension bridge that crosses a bottomless abyss, small caves in the cliffs. Small details: a barrel of moonshine at the tavern door, a single unlit portal arch in a cave mouth, a tiny guard silhouette on the bridge, a gap in the rail where the fog falls away. Accent: warm amber in the tavern windows.
lioncastle: A hidden savage clan lair in tall grass and rocks, a stone altar and an assembly hall in a rocky hollow, lion-shaped boulders on the ridge. Small details: a big ball of yarn and a cat's cradle left on a rock, a saucer of milk by the entrance, a den of sleeping kittens in a cave mouth, a distant maned figure on the ridge. Accent: tawny gold on the manes and grass.
trollden: A dark cave mouth in a forest hillside beside a black river, a crude troll camp outside. Small details: a ragged troll-skin cape drying on a stick, a heap of gnawed bones near the entrance, a crude stick-and-rag doll hanging on a branch, a fat worm creeping at the cave rim, a faint firelight inside. Accent: sickly green on the trolls' skin and moss.
aarak2: A city of bird-folk built on high wind-swept karst cliffs, nests and thatched huts clinging to ledges, rope paths and no roads, winged shapes gliding across the canyon between towers. Small details: a temple with a rising sun disc on a cliff top, a gallery of stuffed animals displayed on a ledge, a stall with dried creatures hanging, a giant nest of straw. Accent: warm orange on the sun temple.
marsh: A gloomy ancient swamp of mires and dark pools under heavy mist, twisted swamp trees, a great gate half sunken in the middle, lights drifting in the fog. Small details: a lone monolith standing on a hill, glowing will-o-the-wisps over the water, a hut among roots where a witch's cauldron steams, a huge moss-covered figure rising from the mud. Accent: sickly green in the wisps and cauldron steam.
warkeep: A hidden warlock's keep deep in a swamp, with a tower, courtyards and a hill refuge, mine entrance in the rock and a roof watchtower. Small details: a glowing pentagram on the tower roof, a crocodile pit in the yard, a dog kennel with a tame falcon on a perch, a distant fire wyrmling's cave glowing. Accent: dull violet on the summoning tower window.
king2: A small stone castle with a drawbridge and a wooden royal road at the edge of northern plains, a tower with a telescope on top, banners on the wall. blight: A blasted northern land beyond mountains, with seven great black towers on a plain, a dead sea, a thousand lakes frozen and grey, twisted trees. cloudymt: A mountain city of dragons hanging among clouds, a walled palace on a high peak with four corner towers, winding mountain roads, dragon silhouettes circling. Accent: pale violet on the king's amethyst tower.
villa: A primitive village of round huts, stone and bone, in a forest clearing with muddy paths and wooden gates at both ends, smoke from a shaman's hut. Small details: a cage of beasts near a hut, a brewer's barrel by the hearth, a spiky blue hedgehog guard figure at the gate, a bear and a wolf tamed beside a cabin. armagddn: A burning apocalyptic plain beneath a scarlet sky, with a lake of fire, a sea of blood, a sunken volcano and rotted forests, a bridge over the Euphrates leading to a throne hall. geometry: A surreal plain of flat ink-wash geometry: a huge quadrilateral and a triangle floating over a line-drawn horizon, sepia shapes stacked like a monument built by drunk, hopeful friends long ago. Accent: one shape washed in faded teal.
daycare: A cheerful dwarven day care carved into a mountain slope: stubby stone halls with round windows, a small playground of stone slides and a miniature hedge labyrinth outside, a stairway down into the dwarven kingdom. Small details: a giant overfed teddy bear sitting by the gate, tiny dwarf toddlers with toy axes far off, an old nanny waving from a balcony. Accent: soft pink on the toy ring and balloons.
zoology: A small stately school-museum building in Midgaard, its upper floor windows showing glimpses of exhibits: a huge shark jaw hung over the entrance hall, glass tanks, a gorilla cage. Small details: a giant jellyfish glowing in a tall tank, an emu standing guard by the door, a gift shop window full of jars. Accent: pale aquarium blue on the glass tanks. No signs and no lettering anywhere on the building.
oldthalos: The thriving ancient city of Old Thalos seen across a strange rift in reality: clay dwellings, a town hall, market square and tall watchtowers inside a dark dwarven forest, with the sky torn open by a swirling hole in the air. Small details: a sacred grove of druids at the edge, a stone fountain in the square, a lone bard with a silver flute on a rooftop. Accent: dull gold on the watchtower tops and amber in the rift.
bazaar: An enormous eastern bazaar inside a sandstone wall: striped tents, domed stalls, camel caravans, a shipyard glimpsed at the far end with a small galley on stocks. Small details: a monkey in a bright red fez on a stall roof, a calligrapher's tent with flowing banners, a rack of curl-toed slippers and fuzzy bunny slippers. grave: Midgaard's old graveyard at dusk behind locked iron gates: crooked tombstones in rows, a small chapel, a gravedigger's shed, mist among open dusty graves. Accent: cold violet on the mist and faint amber in the candle.
hood: A rough walled-in city district seen from above: crowded streets, a ruined magic shop, a vacant lot overgrown with weeds, laundry lines. Accent: dull orange on gang torches and one burning barrel.
sewer: The mouth of Midgaard's sewers: a brick arch with a green-slimed canal flowing out of it, branching pipes and tunnels going down into endless dark caves with stalagmites. hitower: The High Tower of Sorcery rising from a dark grove of shadows: a slender white tower of many floors with obsidian base, glowing windows, lecture halls and a stagnant pond at its foot. catacomb: A vast underground cave under the dwarven kingdom: winding tunnels, a prismatic crystal cave glowing in the distance, ancient stone halls and dormitories of a forgotten knightly order. invader: A vast underground fortress of a secret order, seen across a dim cavern: black basalt pillars, a deep round shaft spiralling down into darkness, a great carved stone circle on the cavern floor, a hall with tall pillars beyond. thalos: The ruined city of Thalos at the edge of a twilight dwarven forest: crumbling clay houses, a broken market square, a half-fallen watchtower, ivy over the town hall. drow: A huge underground cavern city of dark elves lit by a pale glow: spiderweb-draped spires, noble houses carved into the cavern walls, a great hall with a dais and a priestess academy. galaxy: A cosmic world inside a crystal ball: a spiral galaxy of nebulae and stars, a dragon-shaped constellation curving across the sky, a path of stars ending in a temple on a hill. chocolate: A whimsical candy factory valley: a chocolate river with a waterfall, marmalade avenue, a milk-chocolate skating rink, tall brightly lit candy workshops with steam pipes, a glass elevator shaft rising from a tunnel. nirvana: The plane of Nirvana: an endless grid of perfectly straight corridors and right-angle cells under a flat grey sky, a great geometric tower in the centre with a single door. jher: A cave mouth in a bleak hillside leading down to the lair of the snake-woman breeder Jher: stone steps descending into the dark, caged pens, a throne hall deep inside. isles: Five pirate islands scattered across a sunny sea: a jungle isle, a volcano island with lava, a coral reef, an iceberg with a great ice cave, and a flying island above the clouds. tcwnn2: The fortress-city of Anon seen from outside: high multi-tiered walls with parapets, towers, an eastern gatehouse with barracks above and patrolling guards. park: Shady Breezes Park beside a crystal-clear lake: ancient trees, winding paths, picnic spots on the shore, a gazebo, a gentle breeze moving leaves. amber_area: A far shore across the Golden Sea: the delta of a dark river spilling into glittering amber water, a harbour of wooden docks below a terraced hill town, and a grand castle crowning the slope above a winding road. newbie2: A cheerful training dungeon seen from outside: a stubby hill with a wide stone entrance arch leading to a labyrinth of corridors, with cutaway glimpses of tunnels, dark pits and crossroads inside the hillside. rat: A small, unremarkable temple tucked between crowded Midgaard rooftops at twilight, its door a little crooked, a great shadowy rat silhouette carved into the pediment. freeport: A bustling trading port on a rocky northern coast of the Dark Continent: long wooden piers, crowded quays, shipyard cranes, dozens of masts and a hillside town above. ruler: The marble residence of an order of law-keepers rising out of drifting mist, reached by a narrow bridge over a chasm, a symmetrical palace with a grand hall and a small chapel. newthalos: A sprawling eastern desert-and-river city of domes, minarets and flat roofs under the sun, a great bazaar of coloured awnings, a wide river with stone bridges, and a harbour on the sea at the far side. bear: A garish tavern-and-nightclub complex tucked into a hillside, ivy arch at the entrance, a big dancing bear silhouette on a barrel above the door, a rotunda and a sauna steaming behind. ofcol: A small northern village of low timber houses and turf roofs on a windswept plain, a muddy square in the middle, smoke rising from a squat tavern chimney, pine woods and grey hills beyond. firetop2: A great smoking volcano ringed by a river, with a crooked fortress mouth in its flank, a ferryman's boat and a bridge across the water, orc watch fires on the slopes. emerald: A vast ancient forest of towering trees, a waterfall behind a mist, a flower-filled meadow with a village, a small farm with a barn, and to the west a dark dead wood of twisted black trunks.
